subject.title: Browser-opened temporary tabs/windows should close automatically after task completion

question: Should primary-agent task completion close only run-owned temporary browser tabs, and which user actions should preserve a tab?
rationale: Current behavior intentionally keeps active primary-session tabs reusable, so changing the default requires maintainer intent on task terminal events, tab ownership, and preservation rules before an implementation can be safe.

options.title: Run-owned cleanup with preservation
options.body: Track tabs created during a primary-agent run and close only those not explicitly foregrounded, pinned, or requested to be kept.

options.title: Keep idle/cap cleanup only
options.body: Treat the current background cleanup model as sufficient and close this direction as not planned if task-end closure is too surprising.

options.title: Opt-in strict cleanup
options.body: Add a documented opt-in mode for task-end cleanup while preserving reusable primary tabs by default.

recommendation.title: Run-owned cleanup with preservation
recommendation.body: Track tabs created during a primary-agent run and close only those not explicitly foregrounded, pinned, or requested to be kept.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on the tracked-tab cleanup implementation and the reset-specific cleanup replacement.
